name: admin-customers-01
title: Customers admin dashboard
description: A controlled customer list with counts derived from supplied data, name/email search, segment badges and create/edit callbacks. Includes loading, empty, no-results, retry and permission states; pair with customer-edit-01.

docs: Pass customers and wire onCreate/onEdit/onRetry. Empty by default; never uses fictional customer data. Pair with customer-edit-01; server authorization and persistence belong to the consumer.

loading.how: status="loading" disables actions and announces loading.
loading.transition: Supply customers and status="idle", or status="error".

empty.how: status="idle" and customers=[] show first-customer guidance.
empty.transition: onCreate opens the consumer create form.

no-results.how: Search has no matching name/email in a nonempty list.
no-results.transition: Clear search resets the local filter without changing customer data.

error.how: status="error" renders an alert and onRetry action.
error.transition: Consumer retries loading; local search is retained.

success.how: status="idle" renders supplied rows and truthful counts.
success.transition: onEdit receives the chosen customer; consumer opens the form.

submitting.transition: No transition owned by this block.

validation-error.transition: No transition owned by this block.

permission-denied.how: status="permission-denied" hides data; canEdit=false leaves read-only rows.
permission-denied.transition: Consumer rechecks authorization before enabling writes.

unsaved-changes.transition: No transition owned by this block.

offline.how: Map offline reads to error with custom copy; no connectivity detection.

partial.how: Counts cover supplied rows only; no server pagination.
partial.transition: Consumer owns partial-data indicators and loading more.

content.sample: Customers could not be loaded. Try again.

actions.name: create
actions.responsibility: Open a form and persist a new customer.

actions.name: edit
actions.responsibility: Use stable customer ids and protect unsaved edits when switching.

responsive.strategy: Stack header and KPIs on mobile; wrap names/emails, show orders/spend beneath the name, hide last-order column below md.

consumer: Supply real customers; the default is empty. Bind callbacks or their buttons stay disabled.
Authorize reads and writes on the server; disabled controls are not a security boundary.
Maintain stable ids and preserve custom copy, columns and theme tokens across updates.
Offline detection, pagination, remote search and data fetching belong to the consumer.
